question.text: Swachh Bharat Mission is one of NITI Aayog's 41 policy priorities. Which set of SDGs does the chapter associate with this mission?

answer.text: SDGs 1, 6, 11 (No Poverty, Clean Water & Sanitation, Sustainable Cities)
SDGs 4, 5, 8 (Quality Education, Gender Equality, Decent Work)
SDGs 13, 14, 15 (Climate, Life Below Water, Life on Land)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter mapping (Table 1.5 on p31), Swachh Bharat Mission is linked to SDGs 1 (No Poverty), 6 (Clean Water & Sanitation) and 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities). The SDG names are listed on p14. Sanitation is the core SDG 6 linkage. The Trap: Option B covers education/gender/work — different policy verticals. Option C covers environmental SDGs only. Option D covers institution/partnership SDGs. Note: When evaluating an SE programme operating in parallel with Swachh Bharat, attribution must be tested carefully because the government scheme is a substantial co-contributor; the counterfactual should adjust for dead weights to avoid over-claiming (p135).
